entities.name: Mus musculus PRMT5
observations: Exact 100% sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8CIG8; query length 637 aa.

Protein arginine N-methyltransferase (EC 2.1.1.320) catalyzes protein arginine mono- and symmetric dimethylation using S-adenosyl-L-methionine; curated annotation reports preference for monomethylarginine formation.
Established substrates include Sm proteins SNRPD1/SNRPD3, with roles in snRNP assembly; annotated additional histone and non-histone substrates.
Detected Pfam regions: PRMT5_TIM (37–290), PRMT5 (297–464), PRMT5_C (467–635).
Curated localization includes nucleus, cytoplasm, chromatin, and Golgi; forms homo-oligomers and participates in methylosome complexes with WDR77 and CLNS1A or RIOK1.
Sequence-derived estimates: 72.7 kDa, pI 5.99; these are unmodified-sequence estimates.
